newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish parliament starts debate on budget changes.
newsitem.headline: Spanish parliament starts debate on budget changes.

text.p: The debate on amendments to Spain's 1997 budget started in parliament on Monday, and was expected to be completed later this week.
Other issues to be brought before the house include drafts on fiscal and administrative measures, including budgetary discipline, financing for the autonomous regions and complementary fiscal issues.

The budget, for which the minority conservative goverment has the backing of its Catalan, Basque and Canary Island allies, will then be debated by the budget committee in Spain's lower house, the Senate, from around November 26.
Parliament is expected to approve the document in a final vote before the end of December.
